messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high-severity — routing: repeated health-check flapping detected across regions (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu). Multiple fallbacks observed, requests looping and failing 503s. Auto-mitigation kicked but loop persists. Paging oncall @rohit.

rohit: on it. seeing repeated health-state toggles in routing logs. spike at 12:31 UTC.

alice: got the page, joining. customer-impact: some customers reporting elevated 5xx for generation endpoints in us-east. CS says ~8% of requests failing in last 5m.

lee: adding logs — from router: 
```
2026-03-15T12:30:42Z route=smart-fallback src=us-east dest=us-west action=fallback reason=hc_unhealthy
2026-03-15T12:30:43Z route=smart-fallback src=us-west dest=eu action=fallback reason=hc_unhealthy
2026-03-15T12:30:44Z route=smart-fallback src=eu dest=us-east action=fallback reason=hc_healthy
2026-03-15T12:30:45Z route=smart-fallback src=us-east dest=us-west action=fallback reason=hc_unhealthy
```
looks like health-check probe jitter between regions every few seconds.

carol: i'm seeing additional noise: some nodes in us-west are returning 200 for the probe but with latency > 2s causing probe timeouts upstream. Maybe probe threshold too tight.

rohit: hypothesis: probe debounce not applied -> status flips cause smart-routing to cascade fallbacks. also noticed model-variant mapping for eu has a stale variant tag (v2-gpu) that times out under certain seq len -> that may be amplifying failures when fallback reaches eu.

alice: ok priorities: 1) stop the loop quickly (throttle cross-region fallbacks), 2) stabilize probes (debounce), 3) patch variant mapping if needed.

rohit: applying emergency routing fix: temporarily set policy to prefer local-only and disable cross-region fallback for smart-fallback policy. running:
```
rbctl routing update --policy smart-fallback --set cross_region=false --scope env=prod
```
deploy-bot: Executing update: rbctl routing update --policy smart-fallback --set cross_region=false --scope env=prod
deploy-bot: Update accepted, rolling config to routers (20s rollout window).

alice: confirming config push, routers reporting new policy. watch for reduction in fallback events.

lee: fallback events dropped to near zero within 30s. 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 1.2% in top-tier customers.

cs-jan: ping from ops: one enterprise customer (acme-corp) reported timeouts; they're being notified, CS will escalate if they see >5% still.

carol: while loop is quiet, will deploy a debounce patch to health-check evaluation to require 3 consecutive failures before marking unhealthy. small rollout to control-plane:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap health-probe --patch '{"data":{"debounce_count":"3"}}'
```
deploy-bot: configmap patched, orchestration triggered.

rohit: also going to remove the stale model-variant tag on eu routing table to prevent slow v2-gpu being chosen during any remaining fallbacks.
```
rbctl modelmap remove --region eu --tag v2-gpu
rbctl modelmap add --region eu --tag v2-quant --priority=high
```

lee: after modelmap change, eu inference latency normals. no further timeouts observed.

alice: handoff: @lee will own the follow-up telemetry and deploy the probe-debounce permanently across regions. @carol will run post-incident audit on probe thresholds. @rohit please keep the temporary cross_region=false in place until we validate.

rohit: ack. i'll also open a revert PR for policy to re-enable cross-region with added safeguards (max-fallback-chain=1, backoff-window=60s).

rohit: created ticket INF-4123: 'routing: add circuit-breaker & debounce to smart-fallback' and PR #4589 for policy defaults.

alice: escalation notes for postmortem: - root cause: probe jitter + aggressive fallback policy made routing flip between regions, causing cascading fallbacks. - contributing: stale model variant in eu that had long tail latency and caused timeouts when selected.

cs-jan: customers notified via status page: "We experienced elevated error rates for some inference requests due to cross-region routing instability. Mitigations applied; services recovering. Investigation ongoing."

rohit: monitoring summary (12:30-12:43): 5xx peak 9%, baseline 0.3%. P50 latency unchanged, P99 spiked from 450ms -> 1.8s during loop. No data-exfil/security concerns.

alice: ok leaving a live note: temporary policy in place. oncall rotation: rohit -> lee at 13:00 UTC. if anything recurs, page SRE immediately.

lee: will continue rolling debounce out. will also instrument an alert for "fallback_chain_length > 2" to catch future loops.

rohit: closing pager for now, will update ticket and add timeline. great work. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) — severity reduced to low, follow-up tickets created: INF-4123, INF-4124 (probe thresholds), INF-4125 (modelmap hygiene).
